# Code of Conduct

Bullet follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Standards

- Be respectful and welcoming regardless of experience, background, or identity.
- Critique ideas, not people. Harassment, insults, and personal attacks are not tolerated.
- Never share another person's private information, accounts, or credentials.
- Do not use Bullet or its community to cheat against, harass, or harm other players.
- Keep discussions of bans, anti-cheat evasion, or account trading out of project spaces.

## Scope

Applies across the GitHub repository (issues, pull requests, discussions) and the [Bullet Discord](https://discord.gg/e2dH2nUjd9).

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior privately to **Isllan Toso** via [isllan.dev](https://isllan.dev/), or via a [private security advisory](https://github.com/Isllanrx/Bullet/security/advisories/new) if it involves security. Reports are handled confidentially; maintainers may remove content and warn, suspend, or ban participants under Contributor Covenant guidelines.
